propositions: Comment identity must be keyed by persistent local-comment-HLC to Jira-comment-ID map in binding_store, not by normalized body equality, to prevent duplicate-body collisions and support append-only semantics.

Returned Jira comment IDs from add_comment must be captured at both enactment sites (create_one and update_one via handle_update/_apply_outbound_update) and persisted via record_comment_id with write-ahead save for crash durability.

Outbound comment bodies must render through RichTextCodec.to_wire with fit-then-encode ordering, and the _diff_comments codec injection must migrate from _IdentityCodec to the real codec to keep dedup keys synchronized with rendered wire format.

Append-only sync must skip re-posting when either the HLC key is mapped or jira_comment_id is present, with body-equality demoted to secondary fallback, ensuring edits and deletes are never synced bidirectionally.
Cloud acli add_comment must ADF-encode bodies via json.dumps(to_wire(fitted)) after fitting text length, never truncating serialized JSON with the plaintext _sanitize_comment guard.
